projects.name: Sports Illustrated Resort Tuscaloosa
projects.description: Ground-up Sports Illustrated resort on the Black Warrior River with 161 hotel/condo units and 12,000 SF of restaurant and retail space near the University of Alabama campus.
key_specs: Riverfront site on Rice Mine Road

sources.title: Sports Illustrated Resort breaks ground in Tuscaloosa
New details on $150M Tuscaloosa Sports Illustrated resort, al.com

projects.open_for: Early vertical construction. MEP, interior finishes, and FF&E packages.

projects.name: Stadium Trace Village Phase 2
projects.description: Second phase of Stadium Trace Village between I-459 and Stadium Trace Parkway including South Haven Surgical Plaza (80,000 SF, 25-bed surgery center), senior living, golf entertainment, and stormwater improvements. Hoover approved $28M in tax incentives.

sources.title: Hoover approves $28M tax incentive for Stadium Trace Village expansion, al.com
Stadium Trace Village $200M second phase, al.com

projects.open_for: Incentive approved. Pre-construction procurement for healthcare and mixed-use buildings.

projects.name: Costco Warehouse Irondale
projects.description: 152,000-square-foot Costco warehouse and self-service gas station on 33 acres at Grants Mill Road and I-459. Development agreement finalized May 29; site clearing and blasting underway for 26-month build.

sources.title: Costco project moves forward in Irondale, ABC 33/40
When will Alabama's newest Costco open?, al.com

projects.open_for: Site prep active. Structural, MEP, and refrigeration specs opening as vertical construction approaches.

projects.name: Virginia Transformer Muscle Shoals Plant
projects.description: 600,000-square-foot state-of-the-art power transformer manufacturing plant at Shoals Research Airpark. Construction began immediately upon May 2026 announcement; 1,100 jobs at full operation.
key_specs: Power transformers for utilities and data centers

sources.title: Governor Ivey, Virginia Transformer Plant Muscle Shoals

projects.open_for: Greenfield industrial build. Heavy electrical, crane, and process equipment specs active.

projects.name: Doncasters Auburn Superalloy Facility
projects.description: New greenfield facility in Auburn for high-performance vacuum master melt superalloys serving aerospace and industrial gas turbine markets. $50M investment creating ~70 jobs.

sources.title: Doncasters expanding in Auburn with $50M facility, Made in Alabama

projects.open_for: Pre-construction. Specialty industrial equipment and process systems.

projects.name: Vulcaflex Auburn Automotive Facility
projects.description: Italian manufacturer's first U.S. facility at Auburn Technology Park West producing synthetic leather for automotive interiors. Site being prepped for construction; 130 jobs.

sources.title: Governor Ivey, Vulcaflex selects Auburn for U.S. expansion

projects.open_for: Site prep underway. Manufacturing equipment and building systems specs opening.

projects.name: CPT America Tuskegee Automotive Plant
projects.description: Tier-one automotive supplier plant at Tuskegee Commerce Park producing stamped metal components. Initial 350,000 SF facility with potential 700,000 SF second phase. ADECA awarded $400K infrastructure grant.

sources.title: Gov. Ivey awards grant for Tuskegee industrial development, ADECA

projects.open_for: Infrastructure grant approved. Water/sewer extension and plant construction specs active.

projects.name: Huntsville Retail and Restaurant Development
projects.description: Huntsville City Council approved a $240 million retail and restaurant development in June 2026, adding significant commercial square footage to the fast-growing market.

sources.title: Alabama commercial construction activity, al.com search synthesis

projects.open_for: Post-approval. Tenant improvement and site development packages.
